items.title: British Millionaire Says GTA 6 Could Save Players $5,000 by Replacing Nights Out
items.summary: A millionaire says stay in and play GTA 6. Cheapest piece of financial advice this year.
items.body:
Social media creator and British millionaire Mark Tilbury argues in a viral video posted October 31 that GTA 6 could pay for itself if players stay home instead of going out. He estimates what each hour in Vice City costs using a display copy of the game he picked up in a store, and compares it with what a typical night out costs.

It's a light-hearted take rather than financial advice. Still, with the Standard Edition reportedly priced at $79.99, the math isn't crazy if the game keeps you busy for weeks.
items.x_post_text: A British millionaire says #GTA6 could save players $5,000 by replacing nights out. Hours in Vice City vs a Friday at the bar. The math is hard to argue with. #GTAVI

items.title: Edge Magazine Gets 12 New GTA 6 Screenshots and a 16-Page Cover Story From Rockstar North
items.summary: Rockstar shows off swamps, sharks and a very suspicious cop. And no, it won't say whether Jason and Lucia get married.
items.source_name: Edge (via Khel Now, Game Rant, Notebookcheck)
items.body:
Rockstar gave Edge magazine a batch of 12 new GTA 6 screenshots on October 29, along with a 16-page cover feature built on a visit to Rockstar North in Edinburgh. The images show a much wider Leonida than the trailers did.

What the screenshots show, according to coverage of the issue: Vice City's waterfront, skyline and neon-lit streets; a rural Leonida town with low buildings and a motorcycle gang riding through; trailer parks and industrial edges on the outskirts; the Grassrivers swamp, where two armed men ride an airboat with alligators around; an underwater passage with a hammerhead shark over coral; and several shots of Jason and Lucia in new outfits, plus a police officer that fans are already theorizing about.

Rockstar's Rob Nelson told Edge the game is "ready," as reported by Game Rant. That supports the November 19 date, though it isn't a quality guarantee. Rockstar also declined to say whether Jason and Lucia can get married.

The coverage describes a Leonida nearly as large as the playable areas of GTA 4, GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 combined. The original Edge issue is a print magazine, so everything here is secondhand reporting until the issue itself circulates.
items.x_post_text: Edge got 12 new #GTA6 screenshots and a 16-page cover story from Rockstar North: swamps with alligators, a hammerhead shark, bikers in rural Leonida, and a suspicious cop. Rob Nelson says the game is "ready." #GTAVI #Edge

items.title: What Edge Says Is New in GTA 6: Smarter NPCs, K-9 Cops, Scooter Bros Delivery and a WAINK App
items.summary: K-9 cops, delivery scooters and a coffee that makes you faster. Rockstar thought of everything except your wanted level.
items.body:
According to coverage of Edge's 16-page special, GTA 6's systems go deeper than the trailers suggest. This list comes from Khel Now's summary of the issue, so treat the specifics as secondhand.

World: buses and trains are fully functional, days and nights last longer to feel closer to real time, and separate teams built the ads, TV shows, radio stations, political campaigns, pedestrians and fictional brands.

NPCs and police: pedestrians react based on location, personality and what they witness, so carrying a shotgun down the street alarms them more than slinging a weapon over your shoulder. Police can deploy K-9 units, track suspects by clothing and known accomplices, and handle pursuits more realistically. Robbery victims may resist, shoppers may step in, and armed drivers can fight back against carjackers.

Vehicles and items: a Scooter Bros service delivers your personal vehicle to your location, cars can carry tracking devices and have improved fuel management, and the in-game WAINK app helps locate valuable vehicles that criminal buyers want. Coffee boosts stamina and protein shakes temporarily increase health. The summary also mentions a Criminal Profile system, more enterable interiors and deeper Jason and Lucia relationship mechanics.

Rockstar has not published its own breakdown, and the summary contains no direct developer quotes.
items.x_post_text: New #GTA6 details from Edge coverage: smarter NPC reactions, police K-9 units, cops tracking you by clothing, Scooter Bros vehicle delivery and a WAINK app for valuable cars. Coffee even boosts stamina. #GTAVI

items.title: GTA 6 Is 17 Days Out: What's Confirmed, What's Rumored and What Rockstar Disputed
items.summary: 17 days to go: here's the sorted pile of facts, maybes and flat-out denials. Print it, tape it to your monitor.
items.body:
With launch on November 19, a Tech Insider roundup published November 2 sorts the facts from the rumors.

Confirmed per Rockstar, Take-Two and store pages: GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, with no PS4 or Xbox One version. Digital preload starts at local midnight on November 12, seven days before launch. The Vintage Vice City Pack is the pre-order bonus for digital buyers who purchase before November 20. Prices reported in a November 1 roundup are $79.99 for the Standard Edition and $99.99 for the Ultimate Edition (£69.99 and £89.99 in the UK).

Reported but unconfirmed: the 210 GB PS5 install size from store data, physical copies being a box with a download code rather than a disc, and the November 18 review embargo.

Rumors and denials: GamesBeat reported a PC version targeting Q1 2027, citing four anonymous sources, and Rockstar has not commented. A single insider claimed a native PS5 version of Red Dead Redemption 2. Xbox denied the exclusive cloud-streaming report on October 7. Bloomberg reported a budget above $1.5 billion on October 14, which Rockstar disputed without publishing its own figure.
items.x_post_text: #GTA6 is 17 days out. Confirmed: Nov 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S, preload Nov 12. Reported, not confirmed: 210 GB size, Nov 18 reviews, PC in Q1 2027. Sort your rumors accordingly. #GTAVI

items.title: Gesaffelstein and Justice Team Up on a GTA 6 Track - A 50-Track Soundtrack Is Coming in December
items.summary: Two French electronic heavyweights, one midnight drop. Vice City's soundtrack just got expensive.
items.body:
Gesaffelstein and Justice teamed up on a GTA 6 track that went live at midnight local time on October 29. Pre-orders for a 50-track soundtrack are due in December, according to reports around the release.

On the same day Rockstar published a Newswire post titled "Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score by Justice." It confirms the original score was composed by the French duo Justice, Gaspard Augé and Xavier de Rosnay, who are Grammy winners. Justice also wrote the single that debuted in the October 15 launch trailer, "Flower in a Hurricane," featuring Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard.

It's a clear sign of how the game will sound: licensed songs on the radio, as announced earlier this month with six stations, plus an original electronic score built by artists Rockstar picked personally. The game launches November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S.
items.x_post_text: Gesaffelstein x Justice just dropped a #GTA6 track at midnight local time, with pre-orders for a 50-track soundtrack coming in December. Headphones on, wanted level off. #GTAVI #Justice

items.title: Rockstar Lets Journalists Watch an Unscripted 90-Minute GTA 6 Session - Map Said to Match GTA 4, GTA 5 and RDR2 Combined
items.summary: Rockstar finally lets people watch the game being played. A map the size of three games and cops who read your outfit: plan your disguises.
items.body: Rockstar invited journalists into its studio for an unscripted session in which the head of development played GTA 6 for about 90 minutes. Reports from the session say the map is roughly the size of GTA 4, GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 combined, and that police track players based on their descriptions, so a quick outfit change matters more than it used to. These are accounts from the people in the room; Rockstar has not published its own breakdown. Launch is November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S.
items.x_post_text: Rockstar let journalists watch ~90 unscripted minutes of #GTA6: a map reportedly the size of GTA 4, GTA 5 and RDR2 combined, and cops who track you by your description. Change your shirt, Lucia. #GTAVI #Rockstar

items.title: South Park Shows GTA 6 Footage in a New Episode - Rockstar Credited at the End
items.summary: Vice City's biggest star this week: a cartoon from Colorado. Yes, the dog poop scene is canon.
items.body:
A new South Park episode, "Guinea Pig on a Stick," aired October 28 on Comedy Central and included GTA 6 footage that hadn't been shown before. In the scene, Jason hits a passerby with dog poop. Rockstar Games is thanked in the end credits, which is the main reason fans treat the footage as authorized rather than leaked.

Fans noted it is the first new raw gameplay footage since August, aside from the launch trailer. It is an odd but effective marketing move: a mainstream adult cartoon showing your game's physics and humor, with the studio's name in the credits. Rockstar has not commented on the crossover.
items.x_post_text: South Park just aired #GTA6 footage - Jason hitting a passerby with dog poop - and Rockstar is credited at the end. Marketing in 2026 is a wild place. #GTAVI #SouthPark

items.title: Insider: Rockstar Is Sending GTA 6 Review Codes, Embargo Lifts November 18
items.summary: Review codes are out. Pick a side now: believe the scores or the vibes.
items.body:
Insider NateTheHate reported on X that Rockstar has started sending out GTA 6 review codes, and that the review embargo lifts on November 18. Insider Gaming says it independently verified the November 18 date in a report published on October 26.

The reported date falls six days after digital preloading begins on November 12 and one day before the November 19 launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. No time of day or region breakdown has been reported, and it is not known which outlets have codes or whether access is staggered.

Rockstar has not confirmed either detail. Treat November 18 as a reported date, not an official announcement, until Rockstar publishes its own review information.
items.x_post_text: Insider NateTheHate2 says Rockstar has started sending #GTA6 review codes, with the embargo lifting November 18. Not confirmed by Rockstar. Get ready for the review-score discourse. #GTAVI
